task.title: Record the owner's four L4b decisions, implemented and measured at 97996c48, on L4b and L1
task.objective: At 97996c48 the owner's four L4b decisions of 2026-09-22 are implemented: the proposed explanation quality target is adopted provisionally with thresholds unchanged and evaluated by verify:ai-authoring-review, the explanation request asks for an evidence-grounded corrective step, a redacted local review store outside the repository holds every captured answer for a person, and a fix order is optional and blocking-first with a violating order withheld. On the real Qwen3.5-0.8B: benchmark:ai-model-0-8b GO on all 8 (the explanation 71,492 ms at cap against 120,000), verify:ai-explanation-live 5/0, two complete quality runs (9/0, 8/0, 9/0, 8/0) at 17/17 and 16/17 on subject, 6/17 and 5/17 actionable by proxy, 0 misattributed, 0 screen hits, nothing ranked, and verify:ai-authoring-review TARGET NOT MET on criterion 3 with 11 screen-clear answers awaiting a person. Append a note to awkit-djnl.6 and to awkit-djnl.1 giving the commit, the result and what stays open (criterion 3, a person's review of 11 answers, the provisional target, the go/no-go). Refresh the JSONL export. Nothing closes: both stay in_progress. No edge is added or removed. The lease writes .beads/** only, so the owner's untracked scripts/offline-benchmark/ and the already-edited state documents are outside it and untouched.

acceptance.description: awkit-djnl.6 and awkit-djnl.1 stay in_progress, each with a note naming 97996c48 and its live result, no edge changes, the JSONL export is refreshed from the database, and the dashboard reports that its sources agree.

evidence.notes: 177/177 with the Overview banner on 'Sources agree' on round 1, after the two `bd update --append-notes`, `bd export -o .beads/issues.jsonl` and the already-edited state documents: 320 issues (311 plus the 9 Phase N records merged at 434b36e4), 26 outstanding / 294 closed, 180 edges, and both narratives restating 65 PASS / 2 NOT RUN / 0 BLOCKED. Round 2 ran once after the lease release, because active-lease.json is a registered source, and was again 177/177 'Sources agree' with the same counts.

history.released_reason: L4b decisions noted on awkit-djnl.6 and awkit-djnl.1, nothing closed, no edge changed, export refreshed
